description: Guest code verification: correct code opens a session; wrong, expired and exhausted codes are refused.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: "123456".
cases.log: Audit row GuestVerified (no actor; object GuestSession; details { meetingId, guestInvitationId }); session row added.
preconditions: Open invitation I1 (meeting Published) with latest challenge K1, code "123456", created 2 minutes ago, not consumed, 0 failed attempts.
cases.return: GuestAccessResult success with GuestVerified { accessToken, expiresAt = now + 12 hours, meetingId, profileCompleted: false }; K1 is marked consumed and one guest session row is created.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: "123456".
cases.log: Audit row GuestVerified; session row added.
preconditions: As above, and the invitation already carries a self-declared display name.

cases.return: GuestAccessResult Failure(InvalidInvitation) (MSG371); no challenge is read.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: "123456".
preconditions: Invitation I1 is revoked, or its meeting is Ended.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: "123456".
preconditions: No challenge was ever created for I1.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: "123456".
preconditions: The latest challenge of I1 was already consumed by an earlier verification.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: <correct code>.
preconditions: The latest challenge expires at exactly the current time (15 minutes after creation).
cases.return: GuestAccessResult Failure(InvalidCode) (MSG126): a code whose expiry is not later than now is refused.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: <correct code>.
cases.log: Audit row GuestVerified; session row added.
preconditions: The latest challenge expires in 1 second.
cases.return: GuestAccessResult success: the code is still valid.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: <even the correct code>.
preconditions: The latest challenge already has 5 failed attempts.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: "12345" (5 digits).
cases.return: GuestAccessResult Failure(InvalidCode) (MSG126) with remainingAttempts 5; the failed-attempt counter is not increased.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: "12a456" (contains a letter).
cases.return: GuestAccessResult Failure(InvalidCode) (MSG126) with remainingAttempts 3; counter unchanged.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: null.
invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: "654321".
preconditions: Latest challenge code is "123456" with 0 failed attempts.
cases.return: GuestAccessResult Failure(InvalidCode) (MSG126) with remainingAttempts 4; the failed-attempt counter becomes 1.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: <wrong 6-digit code>.
cases.return: GuestAccessResult Failure(InvalidCode) (MSG126) with remainingAttempts 1; counter becomes 4.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: <wrong 6-digit code>.
preconditions: Latest challenge has 4 failed attempts (one try left).
cases.return: GuestAccessResult Failure(CodeLocked) (MSG372): the 5th wrong entry locks the code; counter becomes 5.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: "111111" (the replaced code, typed before the new email arrived).
preconditions: Guest requested a second code: challenge K2 (newest, code "222222") replaced K1 (code "111111").
cases.return: GuestAccessResult Failure(InvalidCode) (MSG126) with remainingAttempts = 5 - K2 failed attempts; K2 counter is not increased.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token>; code: <correct code>.
cases.log: Error log "Could not verify a code for guest invitation {InvitationId}."
preconditions: Saving the session fails with a persistence error.
cases.return: GuestAccessResult Failure(Unavailable) (MSG374); no session is created.

precondition: Guest invitation with a pending verification code.
